* **C. CD15**: This antigen is positive on normal neutrophils and is also positive on some B-cell non-Hodgkin’s lymphomas and on Hodgkin’s lymphoma. Its abnormal expression is not associated with the subject’s condition.
* **E. Ras pathway transcription factors**: While the subject’s tumor has Ras pathway activation, the transcription factors downstream of this activation (e.g. c-MYC, JUN, and JUNB) are not abnormal in this subject.
